title: guardrails team config
description: Schema for a repository's docs/conventions/guardrails.yaml, the team layer of the guardrails plugin's settings. Read only while git tracks it. Contract: docs/contracts/config-cascade/README.md.

fix_request_post.description: Whether hooks/block-fix-request-post.sh blocks an agent from posting the PR-fix lane fix request. block (default) blocks it; allow lets it through. Any other value keeps block.
